描述_EN: so far only one of the figures on the v&a slab has been identified, at the left of the middle register. the sculpture was probably mass-produced from a workshop in the area. the designs resemble those on the walls of a famous group of offering shrines erected between ad 147 and 168 in front of tombs of the aristocratic wu family. the shandong peninsula was where confucius had lived and taught, and the aristocracy of this region were proud of their special role as guardians of his legacy. he is qu boyu, one of the disciples of confucius. the style of decoration of this stone slab taken from the wall of a tomb indicates that it is likely it came from shandong province in eastern china.
描述_ZN: 到目前为止，只有中轴线上的一个人物被确认，在中轴线的左边。 该雕塑可能是由该地区的一个工场大量生产的。 该图案类似于公元147年至168年间在贵族吴氏家族的墓前建立的一组著名的供奉神龛的墙壁上的图案。 山东半岛是孔子生活和教学的地方，这个地区的贵族们为他们作为孔子遗产的守护者的特殊角色而感到自豪。 他是孔子的弟子之一的屈伯玉。 这块取自墓壁的石板的装饰风格表明，它可能来自中国东部的山东省。
